title: PaymentIntentRequest
description: JSON-RPC params for creating a payment intent. V1 records the intent as an evy.transactions row with status "intent" and creates a Stripe PaymentIntent in sandbox mode (manual capture, auto-confirmed with pm_card_visa). Set STRIPE_MOCK=true or use the placeholder STRIPE_SECRET_KEY for in-process mock ids (pi_mock_…). Server-side constants (not request params): confirm=true, capture_method="manual", payment_provider="stripe", fees 0. The buyer-generated `signature` is verified against request params and the payment method's last-4 before any Stripe call or ledger write; verification failure rejects the RPC.

fk.description: The marketplace item this payment intent covers (→ Stripe metadata later).

resource.description: Resource ref of the record `fk` belongs to, e.g. marketplace.items.

amount.description: Money to authorize; must be greater than zero.

currency.description: From the item's price; "AUD" in v1.

authorization_message_id.description: The buyer's original request message (the message stating the price).

signature.description: Buyer-generated proof of payment origin. Verified before the Stripe PaymentIntent is created.
